content.short: Nftfy lets NFT collectors pool resources to buy assets, gain fractional ownership, or fractionalize holdings.
content.description: Nftfy is an NFT investment platform that enables collectors to unite and acquire high-demand assets together, while helping creators reach a broader pool of investors. Groups of buyers can pool funds to meet a collection’s price and share ownership of the work. Creators can list their artwork for sale and attract buyers who want fractional ownership of the piece, expanding funding options for both full and fractional stakes in NFTs.
content.meta: Nftfy is an NFT investment platform for pooling buyers to buy assets and co-own fractions. Discover Nftfy and other NFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
